summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal rulings and retail earnings, with a focus on India's legal landscape and retail sector performance.

bullets.text: UK Court of Appeal rejects India's challenge to arbitration concerning the Andhra Pradesh bauxite project.
Westlife Foodworld reports Q2 revenue of Rs 747 crore, a 16% increase, with same-store sales growing 10.1%.
Swiggy plans to shift to an inventory model in Q3 FY27, aiming for an 80 basis points margin boost for Instamart.
Billionaire Mukesh Ambani's Jio launches India's biggest-ever IPO, marking a significant milestone in the Indian market.
Infosys reports a 6% YoY profit increase to Rs 7,823 crore in Q2, while lowering its revenue guidance.
